# handles — Beta company and partner handles inventory

Created empty 2026-11-05 as a fixture. A handle is tagged only if its owner is
on the cleared list *and* the row is marked `verified`.

## the private companion

Stealth counterparties, unsigned-draft parties and the denylist for this
stream live in `handles.private.md` beside this file, gitignored. A checkout
without it is an incomplete read, and the claim gate blocks this stream until
it is present.

## not to be tagged

Other streams' own handles are partners here only under a pair rule in
`.atelier/memory/streams.md`; without one they are not tagged.
